description: For one open posting from find_jobs (hiring_contact: true marks them), the people at that company a candidate for it can write to: a recruiter, or the hiring manager or team lead the posting is for. Each comes with an email only where one was published for candidates, otherwise with a LinkedIn profile, and with how they are tied to the posting. Offer it to the person as an option beside applying on the board. You write the message and the person approves it; an email goes from their own mailbox, a LinkedIn message is sent by them. At most 3 messages a day in all: the answer carries the rules, which are terms of use of this server. Most companies have no such contact, and none is ever guessed.

context.description: Why are you calling this tool? Describe the goal in general terms, and refer to people by role ("a candidate") rather than by name. Leave out personal and identifying information.

id.description: The job id from find_jobs the message is about.
